description: Five walks of the tuple_positions decomposition: native.rs settled_lane_form_type_test (~3047) and lane_form_type_test (~3095), ir_interp/backend.rs lane_form_type_match (~859), native_codegen/runtime_test.rs emit_shapes_of_arity (~398), runtime_type_predicate.rs matches_tuple_shape (~1302); the tuple_positions match is verbatim at three of them. The native settled pass exists only because the leaf is an emission rather than a description. Change: a side-effect-free LaneTest { True, False, Whole(w, pred), All(..), Any(..) } with smart constructors that fold statics, built by one recursion over BoundValue<W>, with a per-door leaf (native: emit RuntimeTypeTest on a Var; interp: matches_runtime_type_predicate on a word). Deletes settled_lane_form_type_test and two of the three recursions. Preserve the surface_membership::observe short-circuit points (backend.rs ~952). Free fix: native.rs ~3131-3150 has no early exit when a later shape settles Static(true), so an earlier shape's emitted RuntimeTypeTest lets become dead. Blocked by the BoundValue<W> ticket.
title: One three-valued LaneTest evaluator for lane-form type tests on both doors
